national_news.title: Ladakh Begins Self-Enumeration Phase for Census 2027
bullets: Ladakh has commenced self-enumeration from August 17 to 31, becoming the first Union Territory to complete the Census 2027 exercise.
Population Enumeration is scheduled from September 1 to 30 with October 1, 2027, as the reference date.
The September schedule was planned due to harsh winter conditions and difficult terrain, creating around 637 Enumeration Blocks (EBs).

national_news.title: NTA Announces Re-Test for UGC-NET June 2026 English, Commerce, and Sociology Papers
bullets: The National Testing Agency (NTA) announced a re-test for English, Commerce, and Sociology papers following evaluation errors.
English and Sociology papers are scheduled for September 9 and 10 in Shift 1, while Commerce will be held on September 9 in Shift 2.
An enquiry committee recommended the re-conduct to ensure a fair and error-free examination process.

national_news.title: IMD Issues Red Alert for Heavy Rainfall in Odisha and Gangetic West Bengal
bullets: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) issued a red colour warning for extremely heavy rainfall over Gangetic West Bengal and Odisha.
An orange alert was issued for Chhattisgarh, East Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, and Uttarakhand.
Thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds were predicted for several states including Bihar, Jharkhand, and Karnataka.

national_news.title: Annual Shri Buddha Amarnath Yatra Begins in Jammu and Kashmir
bullets: The 12-day annual Shri Buddha Amarnath Yatra commenced to the ancient Baba Budha Amarnath Temple in Poonch district, culminating on Raksha Bandhan.
The shrine is situated 4,600 feet above sea level and features a self-manifested white stone Shivling near the holy Pulastya River.
Multi-tier security arrangements and traffic advisories were enforced along the Jammu-Poonch route by the J&K administration.

national_news.title: India to host 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting in New Delhi
bullets: India is hosting the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting in New Delhi under India’s BRICS Chairship 2026 theme: 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.
The meeting is presided over by Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Bhupender Yadav.
Four key priority areas identified by India include Promoting Sustainable Lifestyles, Afforestation, Forest Fire Management and Disaster Resilience, Circular Economy, and Adaptation.

national_news.title: MoS Dr Jitendra Singh confers National Anubhav Awards 2026
bullets: Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh conferred the National Anubhav Awards 2026 in New Delhi to 15 selected awardees for their contribution to nation-building.
The event featured the release of the Handbook on Pension Mitra and Guidelines for the Nation-wide Digital Life Certificate (DLC) Campaign-Five.
The 'Anubhav' platform enables retiring and retired Central Government, Public Sector Bank, and CPSE employees to share their working experiences.

national_news.title: BWF Badminton World Championships Begin in New Delhi
bullets: The BWF Badminton World Championships commenced at the Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium in New Delhi.
Prominent Indian shuttlers participating include P V Sindhu, Ayush Shetty, and doubles pairs like Satwiksairaj Rankireddy-Chirag Shetty and Treesa Jolly-Gayatri Gopichand.
The tournament features top global competitors across men's, women's, and mixed categories.

national_news.title: India Draw 2-2 With China in FIH Women’s Hockey World Cup Opener
bullets: India played a 2-2 draw against China in their opening match of the FIH Women’s Hockey World Cup in Amstelveen, Netherlands.
Navneet (8th minute) and Deepika (25th minute) scored for India, while Zhang Ying and Ma Ning scored for China.
India and China are placed in Pool D alongside England and South Africa, with the top two teams advancing to the next round.

national_news.title: Magnus Carlsen Wins Esports World Cup Chess Title for Second Consecutive Year
bullets: World No. 1 Magnus Carlsen won the Esports World Cup chess title in Paris, France, for the second consecutive year.
He defeated Belarusian Grandmaster Denis Lazavik 2-0 in the final, remaining undefeated throughout the tournament representing Team Liquid.
American Grandmaster Hikaru Nakamura secured third place after defeating Alireza Firouzja.

national_news.title: DRI Uncovers Large-Scale Illegal Areca Nut Imports Exploiting SAFTA Agreement
bullets: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) under the Ministry of Finance dismantled a major syndicate evading customs duty on areca nut imports.

Importers routed areca nuts from South-East Asian nations (Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia) through Bangladesh, mis-declaring country of origin to fraudulently claim full customs duty exemption under the South Asian Free Trade Area (SAFTA) agreement.

The operation revealed a potential revenue loss exceeding Rs 2,500 crore to the exchequer, with nine persons arrested and approximately Rs 75 lakh in cash along with 160 metric tonnes of areca nuts seized.

national_news.title: Amrit Udyan Summer Annuals Edition 2026 Opens for Public at Rashtrapati Bhavan
bullets: Amrit Udyan at Rashtrapati Bhavan opened for public visits under the Summer Annuals Edition 2026, remaining open until September 15, 2026.
The gardens are open from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM daily except on Mondays for maintenance, with free entry for all visitors through Gate No. 35.
Visitors are required to book their slots in advance online via the official Rashtrapati Bhavan portal, as on-the-spot bookings are not available.
Additional visitor amenities including shuttle bus services from the Central Secretariat Metro Station, drinking water stalls, and first-aid posts have been arranged.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government to Build 100 Modern Bus Stands to Boost Transport
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister announced plans to construct over 100 modern, state-of-the-art bus stands across the state.
The initiative aims to improve road transport connectivity, urban infrastructure, and accelerate industrial development.
The announcement was made during the unveiling of a statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel in Jamui district.

bihar_news.title: Railway Ministry Approves ₹2,627 Crore Sherghati-Kajree Rail Link
bullets: The Railway Ministry sanctioned the 107.89-km broad gauge railway project connecting Sherghati in Bihar's Gaya district with Kajree in Jharkhand's Palamu district.
The estimated cost of the project is ₹2,627.29 crore, executed via East Central Railway's construction organization.
The project is expected to reduce travel distance by about 70 km and boost regional trade and employment.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Warns Government Doctors Against Unnecessary Patient Referrals
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister issued a stern warning to government doctors against unnecessary patient referrals from district hospitals.
District hospitals are being equipped to handle 36 types of surgeries locally to reduce reliance on higher centers.
Strict departmental action has been mandated for unjustified patient referrals.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Directs Expedited Development of Air Facilities in Six Districts
bullets: The Bihar government is accelerating the development of aviation infrastructure and air facilities across six districts.
The move is aimed at enhancing regional connectivity and boosting economic and industrial growth in the state.
It aligns with the broader objective of expanding transport networks in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Hoymiles Commissions 7.7 MW Solar Project in Gaya under PM-KUSUM
bullets: Global energy firm Hoymiles deployed 20 units of 350 kW string inverters for a 7.7 MW solar project in Gaya, Bihar.
The project is executed under the central PM-KUSUM initiative with Naw Dharam Energy as the EPC partner.
The ground-mounted plant aims to supply stable green energy directly to the local grid.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Resume Mining Operations After October 15
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced that mining activities in the state are set to resume after October 15.
The tender process for 28 mining blocks is currently underway, with plans to allot over 30 critical and strategic mineral blocks before the end of September.
The initiative aims to boost industrial expansion, generate state revenue, and support sectors like renewable energy, electric vehicles, and electronics.

bihar_news.title: Ministry of Mines Organises Roadshow for 8th Tranche of Critical Mineral Blocks in Patna
bullets: The Ministry of Mines organized a roadshow in Patna on August 17, 2026, for the 8th tranche of critical and strategic mineral block auctions.
The event was chaired by Satish Chandra Dubey, Union Minister of State for Coal and Mines, alongside Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary and State Mines Minister Pramod Kumar.
The 8th tranche comprises 20 mineral blocks (3 Mining Leases and 17 Composite Licences) covering minerals such as Graphite, Rare Earth Elements, Vanadium, and Titanium.

bihar_news.title: Overview of Districts and Administrative Structure of Bihar
bullets: Bihar comprises 38 districts administered under 9 administrative divisions: Patna, Tirhut, Saran, Darbhanga, Kosi, Purnia, Bhagalpur, Munger, and Magadh.
West Champaran is the largest district by area (5,229 sq km), while Sheohar is the smallest.
Patna is the most populous district, and 7 districts (West Champaran, East Champaran, Sitamarhi, Madhubani, Supaul, Araria, and Kishanganj) share an international border with Nepal.

bihar_news.title: Successful SIR in Bihar led to record voter turnout in assembly polls: CEC
bullets: Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar stated that the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Bihar led to a record voter turnout.
Approximately 70 lakh names were removed from the electoral rolls during the three-month revision exercise.
The assembly polls registered a voter turnout of 67.25 per cent, the highest since Independence.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Sets Rs 5 Lakh Crore Investment Target and New Industrial Policies
bullets: Bihar aims to achieve an investment target of Rs 5 lakh crore by November under new industrial policies.
The state government has announced initiatives to create jobs for 1 crore youths by the year 2030.
The announcements focus on boosting the state's economic landscape through strategic industrial reforms and youth employment.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Plans New Airports and Helipads to Enhance Connectivity and Tourism
bullets: Bihar is planning the development of new airports and helipads to significantly boost regional air connectivity.
The initiative aims to accelerate tourism, trade, industry, and overall economic activity in the state.
The state government is coordinating with the Union Civil Aviation Ministry and concerned authorities for effective implementation.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Announces Block-Level Sant Ravidas Yatras and Eco-Tourism Projects
bullets: The Bihar government directed the organization of block-level Sri Guru Sant Ravidas Kalash Yatras from August 18 to August 20.
Emphasis is being laid on developing natural sites into world-class eco-tourism centers to give a new dimension to state tourism.
The state initiatives highlight welfare measures for Mahadalit, Dalit, backward, and extremely backward classes.
